main_text.p: Crescet per orbem postera, quam neque Tentabit atro dente liuor, Nec fugiens Acheronte tempus Pallente merget. Nam sapientiæ Quos puriores tollit ad ardua Delubra, secretumque vulgo Pallas iter melior recludens, Ducit per altos Aonidum specus, Obliuionem sumere luridam, Aut tristis inuisum subire Non patitur Phlegethontis antrum. Sic B E Z A viuet cui faciles sonat Testudo cantus aurea, Nobiles Seu plangit Heroas sepultos: Seu patrio, latioque sacri Psaltæ recantat pectine carmina, Moresque sueto mirus acumine Lacessit incestos, amica Splendidior pietate mystes. Sic ille vincit fata, Caledonum Qui vixit oris, flexanimes potens Referre versus, atque voce Nectarea Buchananus aures Mulcere doctus: vertice cui datum Sublimiori nubila tangere, Coetusque vulgares, & udam Spernere humum fugiente penna. Sic turba vatum, quos trepido sinu Per bella nutrit ciuica Belgium:

page.notes: Lines are verse and are set as one continuous block, since no stanza breaks are visible; line breaks are shown by spacing only. "postera" is set with a long-s form (poftera) in print; transcribed as postera. "Lacessit" is printed "Lacesfit" and "incestos" with long s; transcribed with plain s and double-s spelling as printed in "Lacesfit", corrected to "Lacessit" by u/v and sense, so a printing error may be present. "vdam" is printed; the vowel u is written as u ("udam") per convention, but the printed form may be a printing error for "vdam" or "udam" (doubtful). "B E Z A" is set with letter spacing in print. Nothing else on the page is illegible.
